subtitle: Maze-solving robot · Microprocessor Lab Finals · A.Y. 2025–2026
specifications: 5,000 mAh power bank · TP4056 charging module · XL6009 motor supply boost

milestones.name: Embedded firmware and I/O bring-up
milestones.evidence: Arduino setup, GPIO initialization, and 9600-baud serial diagnostics.

milestones.name: Ultrasonic sensor integration
milestones.evidence: Left and front HC-SR04 readings with a bounded pulse measurement.

milestones.name: Differential-drive motor control
milestones.evidence: L298N direction/PWM control, forward motion, stopping, and timed turns.

milestones.name: Reactive maze navigation
milestones.evidence: Left-wall following, open-left turns, dead-end turns, and emergency reverse.

milestones.name: Repeatable hardware calibration
milestones.evidence: Tunable thresholds and turn durations are documented; repeatability still needs measured test results.

milestones.name: Closed-loop PID motion control
milestones.evidence: Current firmware uses fixed PWM values and timed turns; no PID loop is present.

milestones.name: Wheel encoder odometry
milestones.evidence: No wheel encoders or position feedback are currently documented.

milestones.name: Non-blocking control and fault handling
milestones.evidence: The current control loop uses delay(); scheduling and sensor-fault handling can be improved.

future_improvements: Add wheel encoders and use closed-loop PID to balance wheel speed and improve turn accuracy.
Replace blocking delays with a millis()-based state machine so sensing and safety checks remain responsive.
Validate ultrasonic readings (timeouts, outliers, and cross-talk) and expose sensor faults in diagnostics.
Log repeatable course runs, calibration values, and success rate so navigation changes can be compared objectively.
Re-test motor thresholds and battery behavior under load; document safe voltage limits for the motor supply.
tuning: 0–255 PWM; tune at low speed on a clear test surface.
Reverse if a valid front or left reading is closer.
Steering corrections are based on the left sensor.
Advance, then execute a timed left turn.
Open-loop timing; recalibrate when battery or load changes.
Triggers a timed emergency reverse when readings appear unchanged.
